column1: # spec/functional/capabilities.tsv — E2E-50/P1 functional taxonomy (ANNOTATION, not a ledger).
# One row per capability a PL/I-80 PROGRAMMER can accomplish. Columns (tab-separated):
#   cap_id  area  capability  coverage_rows  corpus_programs  boundary_note
# coverage_rows = existing spec/COVERAGE.tsv ids that bear on this capability (validated: every id
#   must exist there; an UNMAPPED capability is reported, never invented). Status is NEVER written
#   here — tools/functional_dashboard.py derives it from the cited rows + spec/census/*.
# corpus_programs = names from the 44-program historical census (golden/first8080u), or NONE.
# A capability is PARTIAL when its cited rows disagree, UNKNOWN when they carry no verdict.
# No status may be hand-written into this file.

column3: capability
column6: boundary_note

column3: Write a program or procedure block with OPTIONS(MAIN), nested procedures and END labels
column6: head structure is reproduced on every panel entry; pads/labels are the ABI rows

column3: Declare FIXED BINARY, DECIMAL, FLOAT, CHARACTER, BIT scalars
column6: precision/extent combinations outside the cited rows are unmeasured

column3: Refer to a structure member, qualified or bare, without ambiguity
column6: nested-structure ambiguity in an enclosing frame is still missed (row boundary)

column3: Give data STATIC storage and an INITIAL value
column6: STATIC INITIAL on a member is the wall; non-literal initialisers unmeasured

column3: Declare a FILE and name it
column6: names longer than 8 chars clip in LINK-80's group merge, not in the compiler

column3: Convert between fixed, decimal and float values
column6: mixed-mode routes are authorized per measured shape; unmeasured shapes refuse by name

column3: Concatenate CHARACTER values
column6: literal-with-variable and mixed-type concatenation are refused by name

column3: Add, subtract, multiply, divide and mod fixed-binary values
column6: constant-tracking and parking rules are per measured operand class

column3: Compute with FIXED DECIMAL(p,s) values
column6: pool prescan shadow and dedup laws measured in E2E-52/P1; the DEC formal copy-in cell map stays an open my-gap

column3: Compute with FLOAT BINARY(24) values
column6: p!=24 and float <> in a condition refuse

column3: Test scalars for equality and inequality
column6: variable-vs-expression relation lowering is UNTESTED (row says unknown, not unsupported); refusals are carried by the cited COVERAGE rows and the NEG panel, not by a census program

column3: Compare with < <= > >=
column6: fixed-binary ordered relations on a literal are refused; string relations are measured on both templates

column3: Compare CHARACTER strings in either orientation, bare or qualified
column6: this is the E2E-48/49 family: byte tier only, NO runtime semantics claimed

column3: Use an ordered relation on CHARACTER strings
column6: bare-with-literal mix, <>/>< and ^() over a relation-with-literal still refuse

column3: Combine conditions with & and |
column6: one witness; | at all is unmeasured

column3: Branch on a BIT(1) value and negate a condition
column6: nested & beyond E48A14 unmeasured

column3: Use IF/THEN/ELSE, DO TO BY, DO WHILE/UNTIL, GOTO and labels
column6: computed GOTO and subscripted labels unmeasured; GOTO to a procedure entry is DR's own rejection

column3: Call a procedure with arguments and get a value back
column6: value-returning and float-returning calls have measured refusals; a DEC formal gets a copy-in temp cell map DR measures but my object does not yet emit

column3: Split a system across separately compiled modules
column6: link tier is delegated to the external rune-ci builders

column3: Declare and index a 1-D array with a constant or variable subscript
column6: 2-D/assumed-size arrays are the INVERT/MAININVT blocker

column3: Declare a multi-dimensional array
column6: both corpus users are DR-rejected for other reasons, so no oracle exists

column3: Group data into a structure and address its members
column6: member uses outside the licensed classes refuse by name

column3: Allocate, point at, and follow a BASED structure
column6: BASED of BIT/CHAR VARYING types is unimplemented; traversal reload divergence open

column3: Walk a linked list/tree of allocated records
column6: flagship: byte-exact AND executed

column3: Call a documented built-in (ADDR, SUBSTR, LENGTH, ROUND, ...)
column6: all 52 names parse; DR-verified lowering exists only per-probe — largest unmeasured block

column3: Write to the console with PUT LIST / PUT SKIP and formats
column6: PUT EDIT format-item forms are refused per unsampled class

column3: OPEN/GET/PUT/CLOSE a named sequential (STREAM) file
column6: control-item positions, TITLE operand classes and attach words are the measured stops

column3: Use KEYED/DIRECT/RECORD access, READ/UPDATE with a key
column6: largest untouched surface: no DR lowering of GET KEY or UPDATE has ever been observed

column3: Install an ON-unit and handle end-of-file
column6: only ENDFILE(<file>) is lowered; ON ERROR refuses — measured census blockers on EXPR1/EXPR2 (the only census programs with ON ERROR; UPDATE/OPTIMIST use no ON-unit and refuse for other reasons)

column3: Emit an object the historical LINK-80 accepts and links
column6: slow link/run tiers are delegated to the external rune-ci builders
